messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate on /v1/generate from us-east-1 (p95 latency > 3s) — triggered at 2026-03-15T14:07:12Z. Paging oncall: @oliver-oncall.

oliver-oncall: On it. seeing 502 spikes from a subset of pods. digging into LB and GPU pool.

oliver-oncall: Quick status: backend workers showing OOM/killed in the logs for model-abc-quantized-1. Kernel OOM during long-request sequences. rolling back to model-abc-v2 on the affected nodes.

hema-eng: Recommented fallback policy should've routed to model-abc-v2 automatically; looks like the routing table didn't update after last rollout. pulling logs from router service now.

julia-support: Customers are reporting degraded responses in workspace prod accounts. Escalating to CSMs. Any estimate on customer impact window?

oliver-oncall: Hard to say — rollback in progress, we'll know in ~10m. Adding a banner to status page: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1782 — ETA updates every 10m.

incident-bot: @oliver-oncall acknowledged at 2026-03-15T14:09:03Z. Incident severity: sev2.

sara-pm: Copy. @julia-support please collect top-5 affected customers and any hit to SLAs, we need to baseline for credits. @matt-finance FYI this may trigger billing adjustments depending on SLA windows.

julia-support: On it. First pass: AcmeCorp, NovaChat, MediData, Learnly, ShopNow — all on hosted API, region us-east-1. Some reported < 1 request/min, others timeouts.

oliver-oncall: rollback completed at 2026-03-15T14:18:36Z, error rates dropped to baseline, p95 latency back below 400ms. No further OOMs after node restart and model pinning.

hema-eng: Root cause: a silent config mismatch during the last model rollout — a routing flag (prefer-quantized) flipped without the compatible kernel selector flag. That allowed quantized variant on nodes with older drivers, leading to occasional OOMs for long sequences.

oliver-oncall: Mitigation done (rollback + node cordon + driver upgrade scheduled). Planning a post-incident review.

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 2026-03-15T14:19:10Z. Duration: 12m.

sara-pm: Scheduling postmortem: Invitees @oliver-oncall, @hema-eng, @julia-support, @matt-finance, @eva-ops. Proposed time: 2026-03-16 10:00 PT in #pm-postmortems or Zoom. Feel free to propose alternate.

matt-finance: I'll need a quick impact summary for billing: start/end times of customer impact (per customer if possible), estimated token/request failure counts, and whether fallback reduced effective downtime. Also please include invoice IDs or account IDs so we can apply SLA credits.

julia-support: Sending exported logs and affected account IDs to finance: attached CSV in thread (link: /files/incident-1782-affected.csv). Coverage: AcmeCorp acct-422, NovaChat acct-905, MediData acct-1182, Learnly acct-77, ShopNow acct-310.

hema-eng: From tracing: fallback routing did work for 40% of requests for two customers (Learnly, ShopNow). For others, requests hit the quantized path and saw 502s. Attaching quick numbers: AcmeCorp 8k requests attempted, 2.1k failed; NovaChat 12k attempted, 1.9k failed; MediData 3.2k attempted, 900 failed; Learnly 2k attempted, 120 failed (fallback successful mostly); ShopNow 5k attempted, 300 failed.

matt-finance: Thanks. Two follow-ups: (1) SLA credit calc — we need to confirm SLA window in contract for each account (99.9% monthly). (2) Do we credit next invoice or issue pro-rated refund? Current policy: we apply credits to next invoice unless customer requests refund; finance needs a signed approval for refunds.

sara-pm: Let's prepare a draft customer note and proposed credits. Proposal: apply credit equal to pro-rated downtime for the affected period based on monthly committed uptime. Example calc for AcmeCorp: 12m downtime causes 0.83% of monthly availability impact -> credit X (we'll compute exact amount).

matt-finance: Sounds good. I can fast-track credits for enterprise accounts (AcmeCorp, NovaChat, MediData) once support confirms account contacts and invoice IDs. For smaller accounts we'll queue for next billing cycle. Please cc billing-ops@redwood when posting final numbers.

eva-ops: Action items from triage: 1) Hema to open a postmortem doc and own root cause timeline. 2) Oliver to validate routing table automation and add unit test. 3) Ops to add a canary roll flag to block incompatible quantized variants. 4) Support to confirm affected account IDs and customer comms. 5) Finance to list credit amounts and delivery method. Assign owners in the postmortem.

hema-eng: Created postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.example/postmortems/1782 — will add timeline + RCA + action items by EOD.

julia-support: Draft customer email (support template):
```
Hi <Customer>,
We experienced a partial outage on 15 Mar 2026 in us-east-1 that affected some generation requests. Our engineers rolled back the implicated model variant within 12 minutes and services returned to normal. We will credit your account for the affected period per your SLA. A member of our billing team will follow up with details.

We apologize for the disruption. If you have questions, reply to this thread and we'll prioritize.
```

matt-finance: For the credit calculation we'll need: invoice IDs + monthly committed spend for each customer (or contract value). Julia please confirm those in the CSV. Once I have that I'll produce a credit memo and update billing system (Zuora). Expected turnaround: 3 business days for credits to be visible on next invoice. If any customer requests immediate refund, route request to finance with support lead sign-off.

oliver-oncall: Follow-up tech items: patch router service to validate kernel-driver compatibility on rollout, add e2e test in canary pipeline, and emit metric when a routing flag changes (audit log). Planning to submit PR today: #pr/7893.

hema-eng: I'll own the RCA write-up and ensure remediation task for driver-version enforcement is tracked in the infra board (ticket INFRA-4621).

julia-support: I'll schedule customer comms today after PM approves. Also open a support ticket per affected account with reference INC-1782 and cc finance.

matt-finance: Noted. Once the postmortem is complete, I'll attach the credit memos and close the loop. If anyone needs me to join the postmortem call, I can make time.

sara-pm: Thanks all. Postmortem meeting set for 2026-03-16 10:00 PT. Please add any items to the doc ahead of time. We'll finalize credit numbers during follow-up and assign finance deliverables.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-16T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT).

julia-support: Closing loop — created support tickets ST-422, ST-905, ST-1182, ST-77, ST-310. Uploaded CSV with invoice IDs and contacts to finance channel.

matt-finance: Received. I'll start calculations and share a draft credit memo in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

oliver-oncall: Quick note: temporary mitigation doc added to runbook for similar rollouts: /runbooks/model-rollout-safety.md. Suggest ops review this week. :thumbsup:

hema-eng: Adding final note to postmortem for driver compatibility check and canary policy.

sara-pm: Action owners, please update the postmortem doc with expected completion dates so finance can schedule credits accordingly.

matt-finance: Understood. Will mark action items: credit memo draft (MATT) due +1 business day, apply credits (Finance Ops) due next billing cycle, refund requests require sign-off.

julia-support: Thanks team. I'll post customer comms after PM review and confirm with finance for exact credit amounts before sending.

incident-bot: Thread archived after resolution.
